description: EXPERIMENTAL hotword dictionary of additional street-name forms for the T-one street hotword experiment. NOT a production resource: the production hotword source stays streets.txt (loaded by src/t_one_train/hotwords.py).
language_principle: Do NOT mechanically decline anthroponym (personal-name) streets: the official name is already an invariant genitive-like form ('Мусы Муртазина'), and normative phrases ('на улице Мусы Муртазина', 'с улицы Мусы Муртазина') keep it unchanged, so 'Мусе Муртазине' must never be generated.
Additional forms are only for toponyms/adjectives whose surface form really changes when the spoken word 'улица' is dropped in colloquial speech: 'на Советской', 'с Садовой', 'до Лесной'.
No 'улица'/'переулок' type word is added as a hotword.
No meaningless short forms are added (previous experiment showed short unigrams such as 'ак' create strong false bias).
Numeric 'N лет ...' streets are NOT extended (short components 'лет'/'ак' already caused unwanted bias).

documented_no_additional_forms.reason: Anthroponym streets keep their canonical form (no declension), and numeric 'N лет ...' streets are not extended to avoid amplifying short components such as 'лет'.
